Why brokers partner with us

We act for some of the world's leading insurers with established track records and flexible, solution-based approaches. Building and maintaining strong relationships is core to our business, our product range evolves continually on the back of market research.

  • Direct access to decision-makers
  • Speak to the underwriter who prices your risk, no call queue.
  • Exclusivity and bespoke schemes
  • Niche and specialised products you won't find on every panel.
  • Published service standards
  • Response times you can hold us to, see our Service Charter.

Our product range

  • Car

    Cover for new, young and returning drivers — competitively priced with cover that fits your needs.

  • Travel

    Single-trip, annual multi-trip and family travel cover so you can go away with peace of mind.

  • Van

    Reliable cover for your van, backed by the same great service KennCo is known for.

  • Home Insurance

    Buildings and contents cover for homeowners, first-time buyers and landlords across Ireland.

  • Motor Trade

    Cover for motor traders, dealerships and related risks with underwriter access.

  • Schemes & non-standard risk

    Bespoke schemes and niche risks, talk to an underwriter.
